messages:
anna: FYI — noticed a spike in late-token divergence on the fp8->int4 cascade during the canary for the search-ranking model. Logs attached.

kevin: saw that on the dashboard. late-token BLEU drop ~7% after token ~800. could be calibration drift or headwise saturation.

tj: I reproduced a smaller repro locally. looks like per-head scale clipping increases under longer contexts. KV cache hit rates look stable.

kevin: initial trace snippet: ```gpu_trace: head_saturation=0.14 -> 0.38, scale_clip_rate=0.02 -> 0.12```

sara: @kevin did any quant profile change land in the canary?

kevin: no platform roll, but model team switched quant profile to `aggressive-density-v2` for cost savings. might explain the long-tail fragility.

anna: can someone run a shadow compare: full-prec vs fp8->int4 cascade on late-token evals? I want concrete deltas.

tj: I'll run shadow with the longtail eval set tonight. also add a variant that forces fp8 for tokens > 512.

sara: might be worth shipping a quick runtime guard: fallback to fp8 when a degradation metric crosses threshold. simple policy first.

kevin: agree. suggest runtime surface: expose `deg_score` and `per_head_saturation` in traces and let a guard evaluate them. right now we only have aggregate latency/cost traces.

anna: proposal: `longtail-guard` that triggers fallback to fp8 for tokens > N or when deg_score > T. runtime header `X-Precision-Guard: longtail` to opt-in.

tj: :thumbsup: need to quantify cost impact — fallback ups cost ~25% per request in our sims.

kevin: also need an interface contract change: add `precision_debug` opt-in trace that returns {"deg_score","per_head_saturation","kv_miss_rate"}. keep opt-in to avoid perf hit.

canary-bot: alert: fp8->int4 cascade triggered longtail guard on 3 canary shards in us-west2.

anna: action items: 1) run targeted shadow+eval with `aggressive-density-v2` + fp8-fallback heuristics (tj) 2) add opt-in trace fields `precision_debug` (kevin) 3) draft rollback playbook and comms (sara) 4) RFC for longtail-guard design and rollout plan (anna — I'll own it).

tj: I'll schedule the shadow run at 22:00 PT and post results here.

kevin: I'll open a small PR adding `?trace_precision=1` opt-in flag and unit tests for trace payload format.

sara: I'll draft the playbook: thresholds to watch, `rb` commands for immediate pinning, and a short customer notification template.

anna: if shadow shows reproducible regressions we'll pin that tenant back to v0 and accelerate the canary rollback cadence (canary -> 1% -> 10% -> off). also consider seeding Redwood Optimize with late-token evals for future quant profile recommendations.

tj: noted and tagging @oncall for overnight monitoring.

oncall: oncall here — thanks for the heads-up, I'll watch the canaries and alert if thresholds trip.

anna: thanks all — will collect results and start the RFC draft tomorrow.
